g.text: Residue of chain B, numbered as in the structure file
An interface has no centre. The residues of chain B that touch
chain A stand in a column, as boxes, ordered along the interface
and not by their sequence: neighbours in the column are
neighbours in space; those of chain A around it. A line is a pair
of residues, at the shortest of its contacts of one kind.
All 16 residues of chain B at the interface are shown, with 37
